note: Pool / billiards (D-084), read by PoolRules + PoolTable. Table frame: x along the length (the head / break end is -x), y across, metres, origin = table centre; surface_h = height of the felt. length / width = the playing surface (7-ft bar table). Pockets: corner pockets catch a ball whose centre comes within corner_r of a corner point, side pockets within side_r of the middle of a long rail; the cushions open up within corner_gap / side_gap of a pocket so balls can drop. Physics: decel (m/s^2) + drag (per s, x speed) slow rolling balls; ball_e / rail_e = how much speed survives a ball / cushion hit; sim_dt = physics step, frame_dt = how often the shot is sampled for playback; max_speed = a full-power shot (m/s), min_speed at zero power; stop_speed = a ball slower than this stops. Play: charge_seconds to full power, shoot_range = how close (m, from the cue ball) you must stand to shoot, leave_m = walking this far from the table gives up your seat, sim_budget_ms = host time per frame spent on a shot. colors = ball colours 1-7 (9-15 use the same as stripes), 8 is black.
